action_cards.action_title: Apply for unemployment benefits: California Employment Development Department (EDD), Unemployment Insurance (UI)
action_cards.reason: This program may be relevant to your situation because it can replace part of lost wages after a layoff.
action_cards.next_step: Start the online application. Have your last employer's details and last day worked ready. UI phone line (English and Spanish): 1-800-300-5616, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. (checked Oct 22).
action_cards.priority_reason: Income replacement supports your other needs, and payments take time to start, so file early.
action_cards.processing_estimate: It takes about three weeks to process a benefit application and make the first payment.

contacts.label: How to apply
contacts.value: Apply online through myEDD (UI Online), which EDD describes as the fastest and most convenient way to apply for unemployment and manage a claim.

contacts.label: Contact
contacts.value: UI phone line (English and Spanish): 1-800-300-5616, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Pacific time, Monday through Friday, except California state holidays.

contacts.value: UI self-service line (English): 1-866-333-4606, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
contacts.hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

action_cards.action_title: Ask about help to stay in your home: Sacramento Steps Forward with 2-1-1 Sacramento, Sacramento Coordinated Access System (2-1-1, press 8)
action_cards.reason: This program may be relevant to your situation because it helps tenants at risk of losing their housing.
action_cards.next_step: Contact the provider to ask what help is available and what documents to bring, such as any notice from your landlord. Call 2-1-1 and press 8 (checked Oct 22). Toll-free: 1-844-546-1464 (checked Oct 22).
action_cards.priority_reason: Getting this contact early gives you the most options.
